headline.purpose: "Yapılacaklar" on the navy strip (34px phone, 40px at >=720px), sentence case.

title.purpose: Uppercase auth headings; empty-state titles at 22px.

body.purpose: Task text and inputs; tabular numerals on the whole body.

label-column.purpose: NO / GÖREV / DURUM, Tamamlananlar section head, form labels, İŞ KALDI caption.

row-number.purpose: Zero-padded 01, 02...; navy at rest, red on the next row, muted when done.

motion.name: ease-depart
motion.purpose: Row travel to Tamamlananlar and highlight fade.

motion.name: depart-hold
motion.purpose: Status reads TAMAM in place before the row moves.

motion.name: depart-travel
motion.purpose: FLIP translateY from old position into the Tamamlananlar section.

motion.name: arrive-highlight
motion.purpose: Departed Blue highlight on the just-completed row.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: No travel, no fade: highlight held; all transitions off.

narrative.overview:
The list is a departure board, not a stack of cards. A navy enamel header strip carries the product name and, at the right, a giant count of what is left; under it sits an off-white board of numbered rows in three columns (NO / GÖREV / DURUM). One row at a time is the next departure and is the only thing on the board that turns red. When a task is done its status reads TAMAM where it stands, then the row departs down into the Tamamlananlar section and stays briefly lit there, the way a board holds a just-departed sailing.

Density is that of signage: condensed uppercase labels, tabular figures everywhere, generous 58px rows, hairline rules between them. The surface is flat; separation is drawn with 1px lines, never with shadows or floating cards. The rejected default is the soft white card with round checkboxes.

Light and dark follow the system theme (`prefers-color-scheme`); every color token is redefined for dark, the board keeps its structure, and the navy strip stays navy.
keyCharacteristics: Navy enamel strip over an off-white board; red reserved for the single next task and the EKLE button.
Barlow Semi Condensed uppercase for signage (labels, numbers, statuses, buttons); Barlow for the task text.
Tabular numerals throughout; zero-padded row numbers (01, 02, ...).
Signature motion: TAMAM in place, then the row travels to Tamamlananlar and holds a fading highlight.

rules.name: The One Departure Rule
rules.body: Red marks exactly one task (01, SIRADAKİ) and the EKLE button. Hover states, the caret, focus, secondary links and tabs use ink or navy, never red. Error text is the only other red.

rules.name: The Enamel Strip Rule
rules.body: Chrome lives on navy (`bar`); content lives on the off-white board. Do not tint the board with navy panels or put the list on the strip.

rules.name: The Signage Case Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is for signage (labels, tabs, statuses, buttons, column heads) set in Barlow Semi Condensed. Task text, the product name and explanatory copy stay in sentence case Barlow.

rules.name: The Dotted İ Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is produced by `text-transform` and depends on `<html lang="tr">` so i becomes İ (SIRADAKİ, İŞ KALDI). Never hard-code uppercase strings or drop the language attribute.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Separation is a 1px line. No box-shadow, no floating cards, no stacked surfaces.

dos: Do reserve `signal` red for the single next task and the EKLE button; error text is the only other use.
Do separate with 1px rules (`rule`, `rule-strong`, `bar-line`) and keep every surface flat.
Do set signage in Barlow Semi Condensed uppercase with 0.08em tracking (0.12em at 12px) and keep tabular figures.
Do keep corners at 6px (4px for the checkbox face).
Do keep touch targets at least 44px and every task keyboard-editable (Enter / F2).
Do redefine tokens for dark mode via `prefers-color-scheme` rather than adding a manual toggle.
Do keep UI strings in Turkish and `lang="tr"` on the document.
donts: Don't use red for hover, focus, caret, tabs, links or decorative accents.
Don't add box-shadows, floating cards or elevated panels.
Don't use round checkboxes or a white-card list; the board is rows and rules.
Don't use glyph characters for icons; use inline SVG.
Don't add eyebrow or kicker labels above headings; uppercase signage is for functional labels only.
